pageDescription: Configure the event socket sink, body scanner, log format, and CAPTCHA providers. Changes are saved to the service configuration and take effect after a restart.

format.description: NDJSON schema used by the event socket sink. native = Aegis schema; sicherheitstacho = T-Pot ecosystem; tpot = T-Pot legacy. Requires a restart.

captchaSecrets.description: Secrets are write-only — the panel shows configured / not-set status only, never the stored value. Requires a restart.
